replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Sharing your account with another player is fine, unless it was being used to ban evade.

In terms of boosting, I'm not too sure what you mean. If you mean allowing someone else to use your account in order to get better stats, I don't think we punish for that. If you were using an alt account to farm kills, then we'd run into an issue.
